normativeSemantics.scenarioIsolation: Before every scenario, delete all policy resources, subscriptions, callback queues, DME records, idempotency/action ledgers, fences, locks, quarantine state and injected faults, then install only the fixtureRefs and initialState declared by that scenario.

referenceResolution.jsonPointer: A registry value and a fixture URI may each contain an RFC 6901 fragment. Resolve the registry file relative to this catalog, apply the registry fragment first, then apply the URI fragment relative to that selected value, and deep-copy the final value. An absent fragment selects the whole current value; a URI fragment never replaces or resets a registry fragment.
referenceResolution.embeddedReference: Recursively replace an object whose only member is $fixtureRef with a deep copy of the resolved value before applying edits.
referenceResolution.jsonEdits: Apply jsonPatch as RFC 6902 operations, in array order, after all embedded references are resolved. Every operation must match exactly one existing target unless the RFC 6902 add operation names a new member or array position.
referenceResolution.xmlEdits: Apply xmlEdits in array order with the namespace map declared by the edit. Each XPath must select exactly one node; otherwise materialization fails before the target is called.
referenceResolution.opaqueArtifact: For a non-JSON artifact, fixture resolution returns its exact bytes unless an explicit xmlEdit or fault replaces them.

EXACT_BUNDLE.description: The vendored bundle is the input and exact oracle. JSON values, XML bytes, UUIDs, timestamps and normalized values are fixed after declared edits.
EXACT_BUNDLE.o1ValuePolicy: Exact O1 measurement values are asserted only for vendored or deterministically edited golden artifacts.

LIVE_O1_INVARIANT.description: A live Managed Element supplies its own notification identifiers, file names, DNs, timestamps and PM values. The runner evaluates profile invariants and relations, not equality to golden values.

O1_LIFECYCLE_INVARIANT.description: Provider-assigned identifiers and observed times remain live, but the scenario surface is limited to subscription and PerfMetricJob lifecycle. PM-file rules are inapplicable because no complete notification-retrieval-normalization chain is executed.

O1_NOTIFICATION_FAILURE_INVARIANT.description: The provider emits a failure notification with no retrievable PM file. Success requires observed zero provenance and zero DME publication, so live PM value rules are inapplicable.

O1_RECOVERY_AMBIGUITY_INVARIANT.description: Notification loss drives standard files-list recovery, but empty or ambiguous candidate resolution intentionally prevents normalization and publication. Only recovery selection and no-fake-provenance rules are evaluable.

O1_TLS_FAILURE_INVARIANT.description: TLS rejection occurs before HTTP parsing and therefore before any O1 notification, retrieval or PM value exists. The security zero-side-effect rule is the sole evaluable assertion.

DEPLOYMENT_INVARIANT.description: The validated deployment vector is the baseline. A scenario deep-copies only the named value, applies declared edits and evaluates machine constraints without changing the supplied vector or making an undeclared target call.

timeModel.FIXED_LOGICAL: Scenario time origin is an RFC 3339 UTC Z instant. atMs is monotonic elapsed milliseconds from that origin. Array order breaks ties. Wall-clock changes do not change atMs.
timeModel.LIVE_OBSERVED: The runner records observed UTC Z timestamps and monotonic elapsed time. It may not replace live timestamps with golden timestamps.
timeModel.timeoutBoundary: A condition scheduled at exactly a timeout is processed after the timeout; therefore success must occur at an elapsed value strictly less than the timeout.
timeModel.clockSkew: Cross-system skew greater than 250 ms forces O1/action correlation to AMBIGUOUS and status ordering to producerEpoch/statusSeq.

faultModel.activation: A fault names afterStep or beforeStep and is activated exactly at that boundary. A DROP_* fault discards only the named delivery unless repeat is supplied. A CRASH_* fault terminates the named process after its durable effects through afterStep and before any later step.
faultModel.retrievedByteFlipBoundary: FLIP_RETRIEVED_BYTE uses afterStep naming O1_RETRIEVE as its only legal boundary. It interposes exactly once after retrieval has captured all bytes and before expected-digest comparison, byteSha256 emission, XML parsing or normalization; beforeStep and repeat are forbidden for this fault.
faultModel.e2WriteCounting: normalRanWrites and rollbackRanWrites count state-changing effects applied by the deterministic RAN stub, not HTTP attempts, E2 request transmissions or acknowledgements. A fault declaring effectApplied fixes the count without inference.

completeExpectedResult.notApplicable: Use null for a field that has no semantic surface in the scenario. UNCHANGED means byte-equivalent canonical resource or state to the precondition. DERIVED_BY_PROFILE means the live result is computed from the profile and is not an exact golden value.

executionBinding.preflight: The runner validates the deployment vector, resolves all fixture/static expressions, type-checks every earlier-step output reference and rejects undefined suites, operations, initial states, faults, expressions or outputs before any network side effect.
executionBinding.responseOutputs: A creating step captures producer-assigned identifiers from its response; later steps reference steps.<id>.outputs.<name> and never predict an identifier.
executionBinding.nullAtMs: In LIVE_OBSERVED mode null starts immediately after the previous step completes and waits only for the declared event under the runner timeout. null is invalid in FIXED_LOGICAL mode.
executionBinding.dmeAtomicity: Every R1_DME_PUBLISH invocation carries exactly one evidence record and receives exactly one HTTP response; arrays and record envelopes are forbidden.
executionBinding.conditionalApplicability: An applicability.when expression is evaluated during runner preflight. False yields passing SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE with zero initial-state installation, faults or target calls, exactly as defined by the runner contract.

a1p-producer-conformance.semantics: Exercise the actual A1-P v2 Producer through HTTP and the standard status callback; internal producer objects are never imported.

end-to-end-contract.semantics: Exercise the integrated rApp, Non-RT RIC Framework and xApp exclusively through standard R1, A1, E2 and O1 boundaries.

o1-consumer-normalizer-conformance.semantics: Feed the O1 consumer exact or live notification/SFTP inputs, run production normalization and observe individual R1 DME record deliveries.

o1-provider-profile-conformance.semantics: Exercise the real O1 Provider through NETCONF/YANG, FileDataReportingMnS, HTTPS notification and SFTP with live-value invariants.

r1-service-conformance.semantics: Exercise the actual Non-RT RIC Framework R1 service boundary with a contract-faithful rApp harness. Consumer onboarding/authentication and discovery remain baseline obligations. Service registration is exercised only when the rApp intentionally publishes a general request-response R1 API; its onboarding identity and DME push callback are not such an API. Applicable registration, discovery, A1 policy management, status callbacks and DME data jobs use the pinned ETSI TS 104 231 resources and Version headers; no project-specific policy or data endpoint is allowed.

o1-lifecycle-contract.semantics: Run the identical subscription, PerfMetricJob, notification-loss recovery and teardown recipe at the O1 consumer/provider service boundary in both ownership directions. Every NETCONF/YANG lifecycle action is executed exactly from fixture://o1NetconfYangProfile and its registered XML RPC fixtures; neither side may replace the standard boundary with an internal object call.

stepVocabulary.HTTP: Invoke the named endpoint with method, headers, query and body. A bodyRef is resolved by the reference rules.
stepVocabulary.A1_SEED_RESOURCE: Install the resolved policy and declared status without running an episode; this is harness setup, not a target API shortcut.
stepVocabulary.A1_EMIT_STATUS: Cause the target to persist a new declared status snapshot and deliver its standard callback when subscribed. An explicitly declared replay=true re-delivers an existing snapshot without persistence; an undeclared duplicate or regression fails.
stepVocabulary.KPM_SNAPSHOT: Deliver one coherent snapshot with the declared freshness, serving cell and unique decision outcome.
stepVocabulary.E2_CONTROL_RESULT: The deterministic E2/RAN stub returns the declared result and applies effectApplied exactly once when true.
stepVocabulary.READBACK: Return the declared serving cell or declared quality without causing a write.
stepVocabulary.SET_DEPENDENCY: Set readiness, lock, validity or connectivity exactly as declared.
stepVocabulary.DECISION_RESULT: Harness-only injection at the xApp decision-to-control safety-guard boundary. It supplies the declared selected cell after a valid KPM input so the production guard can be black-box tested; it is not a production wire API and cannot directly cause an E2 write.
stepVocabulary.E2_STUB_LOG: Read the externally captured deterministic E2/RAN stub boundary log: control requests, results, state-changing normal effects and rollback effects. It cannot inspect target process memory, ledgers, locks or fences.
stepVocabulary.E2_INVENTORY_VALIDATE: Validate a deep-copied E2 capability inventory, including READY active-connection/function implications and pairwise uniqueness of RFC 8785-canonical structured globalE2NodeId values; failure is fail-closed before E2 control.
stepVocabulary.PROCESS_RESTART: Restart the named component using only its durable state.
stepVocabulary.O1_NOTIFY: POST an SDO notifyFileReady document to the O1 notification recipient.
stepVocabulary.O1_RETRIEVE: Return the exact artifact bytes for the notification fileLocation unless a fault replaces them.
stepVocabulary.O1_NORMALIZE: Purely parse and normalize retrieved O1 bytes into an ordered records array plus commit-eligible, rejected and duplicate subsets. It performs no network call; each later R1_DME_PUBLISH consumes exactly one record.
stepVocabulary.O1_FILE_LIST: GET the standard files collection with fileDataType, beginTime and endTime. The provider returns exactly the declared FileInfo list.
stepVocabulary.PERF_METRIC_JOB: Create, reconcile, lock, unlock or delete the PerfMetricJob through NETCONF/YANG exactly as defined by fixture://o1NetconfYangProfile and its lifecycle/teardown request fixtures; the action is complete only after schema-mount verification and the required readback confirms the declared state.
stepVocabulary.R1_DME_REGISTER: POST DmeTypeRelatedCapabilities to the data-registration production-capabilities collection with Version 2.0.0-alpha.2 and require 201 plus Location identifying the registration item.
stepVocabulary.R1_DME_DISCOVER: GET the data-discovery dme-types collection or item with Version 2.0.0 and verify the requested DME type and compatible delivery schema/method.
stepVocabulary.R1_DME_DATA_JOB: Before create, generate and durably persist a unique opaque 128-bit deliveryBindingId, set PUSH_HTTP pushDeliveryDetailsHttp.dataPushUri to configured r1.dme.policyEvidencePushBaseUri/{deliveryBindingId}, then map that binding to the producer-assigned dataJobId from the 201 Location. Create, query, update, status-query and cancel only through data-access/v2/data-jobs resources with Version 2.0.0-alpha.2.
stepVocabulary.R1_DME_PUBLISH: Resolve an active matching DataJobInfo and POST exactly one schema-bound evidence record as application/json to its bound pushDeliveryDetailsHttp.dataPushUri. Arrays and record envelopes are forbidden. The payload contains no dataJobId and no non-standard correlation header. Route binding plus mTLS/OAuth identity and payload correlation select the job; one 204 commits that one record and 4xx commits zero. Never invent or call a /data resource.
stepVocabulary.R1_DME_QUERY: Query the DataJobInfo item/status and assert correlation over payloads already accepted at its configured dataPushUri; for ONE_TIME PULL_HTTP only, GET the producer-returned pullDeliveryDetailsHttp.dataPullUri. Filters belong to productionJobDefinition, never to a fabricated /data GET.
stepVocabulary.COORDINATOR_TRANSITION: Record a synthetic transition for a narrow contract assertion only; it is never accepted as evidence that the Coordinator executed.
stepVocabulary.COORDINATOR_PROCESS_INTENT: Invoke RAppCoordinatorAdapter.process_intent through the deterministic mock LLM profile and expose the real OranIntentCoordinator FSM history, terminal outcome, terminal evidence and ledger references.

RULE-COMPACT-ORACLE-CONSISTENCY.semantics: For every compactExpectationId, find exactly one object with that id in fixture://golden#/scenarioExpectations. For every mapped expected field present in both objects, the values must be identical after the declared transformation; any mismatch invalidates the catalog before a target is called.

RULE-POLICY-TYPE-DIGEST.semantics: The discovered policy type identifier is AIC_UECellSteering_1.0.0 and RFC 8785 SHA-256 of its policySchema and statusSchema equals the corresponding golden digest references.

RULE-LOCATION-STABLE.semantics: All successful retries return the same policyId, Location and canonical resource body as the first committed response.

RULE-R1-RESPONSE-ASSIGNED-ID.semantics: For R1 create resources whose identifier is server-assigned, the POST request omits that identifier, the 201 representation contains it, and the Location final path segment is byte-equal to it. Every later item request uses only the captured response value.

RULE-R1-SERVICE-REGISTRATION.semantics: The ServiceAPIDescription POST omits apiId and describes a normal REQUEST_RESPONSE API with apiVersion v1 and vendorSpecific-o-ran.org.fullApiVersions containing exactly the required full version 1.0.0. The server-assigned apiId in the 201 body equals the Location final segment; query, update and delete reuse that captured value.

RULE-R1-SERVICE-DISCOVERY.semantics: Discovery calls the case-sensitive /allServiceAPIs resource with api-invoker-id. api-version is the URI-major v1; every returned fullApiVersions string matches the strict SemVer 2.0.0 grammar, and the filtered A1 description contains exact full version 1.0.0.

RULE-R1-A1-UPDATE-BODY.semantics: R1 A1 policy POST carries the create wrapper, but PUT of the policy item carries the bare PolicyObject. Any declared RFC 6902 edit therefore targets /trace/... directly and every item operation uses the Location-assigned policyId.

RULE-R1-DME-WIRE-FORMS.semantics: DME registration, discovery and DataJobInfo create are byte-structure checked against scenario-runner-contract.1.0.1.json#/r1WireContracts: exact member sets, structured DmeTypeId, inline production schema object, canonical record-schema JSON text, plural dataDeliveryModes, percent-encoded discovery item identifier, exact four-field productionJobDefinition, and no response-only dataJobInfoStatus in the request.

RULE-NO-DUPLICATE-EPISODE.semantics: A retry or duplicate input with the same ledger identity creates no additional episodeId.

RULE-NO-DUPLICATE-ACTUATION.semantics: The scenario produces no additional state-changing RAN effect after the first ledgered action.

RULE-STATUS-DEDUPE.semantics: The consumer applies a status snapshot at most once per policyId, producerEpoch and statusSeq; lower sequence or old epoch cannot regress current state.

RULE-FENCE.semantics: While a policy or UE fence is set, no new normal episode or normal RAN write starts.

RULE-E2-INVENTORY-READY.semantics: Validate e2-capability-inventory.1.0.0.schema.json and its machine semantic constraints. READY implies every connection is active and the required KPM function 2 and RC function 3 are active. RFC 8785-canonical structured globalE2NodeId values are pairwise distinct. Any violation yields AIC_E2_INVENTORY_NOT_READY before E2 control with zero control requests, zero normal writes and zero rollback writes.

RULE-PARTIAL-NACK-NO-ROLLBACK-RECOVERY.semantics: When NACK has writeMayHaveOccurred=true and APPLY_FAILED is not preauthorized for rollback, terminal APPLY_FAILED is forbidden. Persist the fence, report NOT_ENFORCED plus policyState RECOVERY_PENDING plus episodeState RECOVERY_PENDING, send no rollback or normal write, and use readback-only recovery; target resolves to APPLIED_VERIFIED, another known cell to READBACK_MISMATCH, and the recovery deadline to QUARANTINED.

RULE-R1-CORRELATION.semantics: R1 preserves policyId, policyRevision, episodeId, transactionId, actionId, scope, window and source metadata without inventing a UE identity from NRCellDU PM.

RULE-R1-DME-PUSH-BINDING.semantics: Every PUSH_HTTP data job has a fresh opaque 128-bit deliveryBindingId persisted before create. Its dataPushUri is configured base URI plus only that binding. Every publish supplies that identifier only as the scalar step bindings.deliveryBindingId used by endpoint expansion; a top-level step field or catalog constant is forbidden. After 201, the binding maps to the Location-assigned dataJobId. Callback routing, authenticated peer identity and evidence payload correlation must all agree; the payload and headers add no non-standard dataJobId. Valid delivery returns 204 and replay uses the same binding-aware dedupe identity.

RULE-O1-NOTIFY-AND-RETRIEVAL.semantics: For a delivered notifyFileReady, the O1 consumer accepts the valid subscribed notification with 204, treats href as producer object URI, retrieves only from fileInfoList.fileLocation, and rejects mismatched job/profile metadata. For an explicitly dropped-notification recovery scenario, the evaluator instead observes the declared drop plus retrieval from the uniquely selected standard files-list FileInfo; one of these two concrete paths must execute, so absence of both can never pass.

RULE-O1-LIVE-VALUE-INVARIANTS.semantics: For live input, RRU.PrbDl is an integer in 0..100 percent with PERIOD_MEAN and DRB.UEThpDl, when present, is a nonnegative real in kbit/s with DERIVED_RATIO; equality to any golden sample value is forbidden.

RULE-O1-DN-BIJECTION.semantics: The full measured object DN resolves to exactly one capability-manifest CellId and that CellId resolves back to the same DN; otherwise quarantine the input and publish no evidence.

RULE-O1-TIME-RELATIONS.semantics: window.start is before window.end; observedAt equals the PM granularity-period end; readyAt and retrievedAt are not before window.end; measurementAgeMs equals evaluationNow minus window.end; ingestLatencyMs equals retrievedAt minus window.end.

RULE-O1-FILE-TEMPORAL-ORDER.semantics: For notifyFileReady, eventTime equals every referenced FileInfo.fileReadyTime; fileReadyTime is strictly before fileExpirationTime; after retrieval, fileReadyTime is less than or equal to retrievedAt and retrievedAt is strictly before fileExpirationTime. Any violation is rejected before retrieval-derived normalization and produces zero R1 DME publish.

RULE-O1-QUALITY-PRECEDENCE.semantics: A record-level ambiguityReason overrides sample aggregation and requires record quality AMBIGUOUS. Without ambiguityReason, record quality is the leftmost present sample quality in NOT_AVAILABLE, MISSING, STALE, SUSPECT, OK. AMBIGUOUS without a supported ambiguityReason is invalid; only OK evidence is commit-eligible.

RULE-O1-RAW-DIGEST-SELF-CONSISTENT.semantics: Evidence source.file.sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of the exact retrieved bytes and duplicate identity uses that digest with job, DN, window and measurement name.

RULE-O1-POSITIONAL-MAP.semantics: Each measResult r is associated only through its integer p index with measType having the same p; lexical name sorting is forbidden.

RULE-O1-NULL-NOT-ZERO.semantics: NIL or noValue becomes JSON null with NOT_AVAILABLE and is never replaced by numeric zero.

RULE-O1-ZERO-VALID.semantics: A numeric zero satisfying the measurement type and range remains value 0 with OK quality.

RULE-O1-SUSPECT.semantics: suspect=true makes every affected sample and record SUSPECT even when numeric values are present, and no such record is commit evidence.

RULE-O1-DEDUP.semantics: Inputs with the same fileSha256, perfMetricJobId, managedObjectDn, window and measurementName produce one normalized sample and one record per measurement scope.

RULE-O1-DIGEST-GATE.semantics: If retrieved bytes do not match the exact-fixture expected digest, quarantine the file before parsing and publish zero evidence records.

RULE-O1-OVERLAP.semantics: If actionOccurredAt is greater than or equal to window.start and strictly less than window.end, record phase is OVERLAPS_ACTION, record quality is AMBIGUOUS, ambiguityReason is ACTION_WINDOW_OVERLAP and commit is forbidden; each sample retains its intrinsic parsed quality such as SUSPECT.

RULE-O1-FINAL-SOURCE.semantics: E2-only KPI can drive Near-RT decisions but cannot satisfy final O1 assurance; absent required O1 RRU.PrbDl yields MISSING and fail-closed commit.

RULE-O1-SUBSCRIPTION-LIFECYCLE.semantics: The canonical subscription POST body is exactly consumerReference=<configured HTTPS o1.fileDataReporting.consumerReference> and timeTick=0 for the indefinite profile. The consumer persists the complete 201 Subscription representation and the identifier derived from the Location final path segment before unlocking the PerfMetricJob. Normal restart reuses the stored identifier without POST. Uncertain state keeps the job LOCKED, obtains definitive DELETE 204 or already-absent 404 for the stored identifier, performs at most one new POST, persists its representation and identifier, then unlocks. Teardown locks or deletes the job, drains in-flight work, then DELETEs the subscription with 204 or convergent 404.

RULE-O1-FILES-RECOVERY.semantics: After an expected measurement-window notification timeout, GET the standard files resource with fileDataType=PERFORMANCE and a fileReadyTime search interval derived from measurement window.end: begin=end+0 ms inclusive and end=end+120000 ms exclusive. The 200 body is a raw array(FileInfo). Select profile/job/DN candidates, retrieve their SFTP bytes, parse raw PM XML and finally require its measurement window to equal the original expected window. Zero final matches or more than one final match yields UNKNOWN/MISSING; exactly one yields normal normalization and DME delivery.

RULE-NO-ACTION-DETERMINISM.semantics: IMPROVEMENT_BELOW_THRESHOLD is valid only when a fresh coherent snapshot has an eligible best target whose calculated improvement is strictly below improvementThresholdPrb. NO_ELIGIBLE_TARGET is valid only when the same kind of snapshot has no eligible non-serving target. Both are terminal NO_ACTION with complete observation metadata, zero E2 control attempts and zero writes.

RULE-O1-NO-FAKE-PROVENANCE.semantics: Without a retrieved and validated PM file, publish no DME evidence record and create no source.file, pmRecord, raw filename, digest, size or measured-object provenance.

RULE-SECURITY-ZERO-SIDE-EFFECT.semantics: TLS, authentication or authorization rejection occurs before resource mutation, callback enqueue, evidence publication or RAN write.
